steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run:
python --version
pip install -U pip
pip install --group dev-cli --group test-extending

steps.name: Build NumPy debug
steps.run:
spin build -- -Dbuildtype=debug -Dallow-noblas=true \
  -Dpython.allow_limited_api=true

steps.name: Run test suite
steps.run: spin test -- --timeout=600 --durations=10

steps.name: Install build and test dependencies from PyPI
steps.run: pip install --group build --group test    # includes hypothesis

steps.name: Install gfortran and setup OpenBLAS 32 bits
steps.run:
set -xe
sudo apt update
sudo apt install gfortran libgfortran5
python -m pip install --group openblas32
mkdir -p ./.openblas
python -c"import scipy_openblas32 as ob32; print(ob32.get_pkg_config())" > ./.openblas/scipy-openblas.pc

steps.name: Install as editable
steps.run: pip install -e . --no-build-isolation

steps.name: Run full test suite
steps.run:
pytest numpy --durations=10 --timeout=600 --cov-report=html:build/coverage
# TODO: gcov

steps.name: Creates new container
steps.run:
docker run --name the_container --interactive \
  -v $(pwd):/numpy arm32v7/ubuntu:24.04 /bin/linux32 /bin/bash -c "
  apt update &&
  apt install -y ninja-build cmake git python3 python-is-python3 python3-dev python3-pip python3-venv
"
docker commit the_container the_container

steps.name: Meson Build
steps.run:
docker run --rm -e "TERM=xterm-256color" \
  -v $(pwd):/numpy the_container \
  /bin/script -e -q -c "/bin/linux32 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail -c '
    cd /numpy &&
    python -m venv venv &&
    source venv/bin/activate &&
    python -m pip install --upgrade pip &&
    python -m pip install --group dev-cli &&
    python -m pip install --group test-extending &&
    spin build
  '"

steps.name: Meson Log
steps.run: cat build/meson-logs/meson-log.txt

steps.name: Run Tests
steps.run:
docker run --rm -e "TERM=xterm-256color" \
  -v $(pwd):/numpy the_container \
  /bin/script -e -q -c "/bin/linux32 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail -c '
    cd /numpy && source venv/bin/activate && spin test -m full -- --timeout=600 --durations=10
  '"

steps.name: Install build and benchmarking dependencies
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install libopenblas-dev ninja-build
pip install --group dev-cli --group bench

steps.name: Install NumPy
steps.run: spin build -- -Dcpu-dispatch=none

steps.name: Appease asv's need for machine info
steps.run: asv machine --yes --config benchmarks/asv.conf.json

steps.name: Run benchmarks
steps.run: spin bench --quick

steps.name: Install gfortran and setup OpenBLAS (sdist build)
steps.run:
set -xe
python -m pip install --group openblas64
mkdir -p ./.openblas
python -c"import scipy_openblas64 as ob64; print(ob64.get_pkg_config())" > ./.openblas/scipy-openblas.pc

steps.name: Build a wheel via an sdist
steps.run:
pip install build
python -m build
pip install dist/numpy*.whl

steps.name: Install test dependencies
steps.run: pip install --group test-extending

steps.name: Run test suite
steps.run:
cd tools
pytest --pyargs numpy -m "not slow"

steps.name: Test SWIG binding
steps.run:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install make swig
pip install setuptools
make -C tools/swig/test test

steps.name: Install build and test dependencies from PyPI
steps.run:
python -m pip install --group test-extending
python -m pip install -r array-api-tests/requirements.txt

steps.name: Build and install NumPy
steps.run: python -m pip install . -v -Csetup-args=-Dallow-noblas=true -Csetup-args=-Dcpu-baseline=none -Csetup-args=-Dcpu-dispatch=none

steps.name: Run the test suite
steps.run:
cd ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/array-api-tests
pytest array_api_tests -v -c pytest.ini -n 4 --max-examples=1000 --derandomize --disable-deadline --xfails-file ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/tools/ci/array-api-xfails.txt

steps.name: Checkout Eigen from GitHub mirror
steps.run:
git submodule init
git config submodule.third_party/eigen.url https://github.com/eigen-mirror/eigen.git
git submodule update --init --depth=1

steps.name: Install build and test dependencies from PyPI
steps.run:
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install --group test-extending
python -m pip install --upgrade scikit-build-core cmake

steps.name: Build and install NumPy
steps.run: python -m pip install . -v -Csetup-args=-Dallow-noblas=true -Csetup-args=-Dcpu-baseline=none -Csetup-args=-Dcpu-dispatch=none

steps.name: Build and install ml_dtypes
steps.run:
cd ml_dtypes
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" --no-build-isolation

steps.name: Run ml_dtypes tests with current NumPy
steps.run:
python -m pip show numpy
cd ml_dtypes
python -m pytest -n 2 ml_dtypes/tests

steps.name: Replace NumPy with 2.0.x
steps.run:
python -m pip install --force-reinstall "numpy==2.0.*"
python -m pip show numpy

steps.name: Run ml_dtypes tests with NumPy 2.0.x
steps.run:
cd ml_dtypes
python -m pytest -n 2 ml_dtypes/tests

steps.name: Install build and test dependencies from PyPI
steps.run:
pip install --group dev-cli
pip install "vulture!=2.15"

steps.name: Build and install NumPy
steps.run:
# Install using the fastest way to build (no BLAS, no SIMD)
spin build -j2 -- -Dallow-noblas=true -Dcpu-baseline=none -Dcpu-dispatch=none

steps.name: Check build-internal dependencies
steps.run: ninja -C build -t missingdeps

steps.name: Check installed test and stub files
steps.run: python tools/check_installed_files.py $(find ./build-install -path '*/site-packages/numpy')

steps.name: Check for unreachable code paths in Python modules
steps.run:
# Need the explicit `bash -c` here because `grep` returns exit code 1 for no matches
bash -c "! vulture . --min-confidence 100 --exclude doc/,vendored-meson/ | grep 'unreachable'"

steps.name: Check usage of install_tag
steps.run:
rm -rf build-install
./vendored-meson/meson/meson.py install -C build --destdir ../build-install --tags=runtime,python-runtime,devel
python tools/check_installed_files.py $(find ./build-install -path '*/site-packages/numpy') --no-tests

steps.name: Checkout and initialize submodules
steps.run:
git config --global --add safe.directory $PWD
if [ $GITHUB_EVENT_NAME != pull_request ]; then
    git clone --recursive --branch=$GITHUB_REF_NAME https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
    git reset --hard $GITHUB_SHA
else
    git clone --recursive https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
    git fetch origin $GITHUB_REF:my_ref_name
    git checkout $GITHUB_BASE_REF
    git -c user.email="you@example.com" merge --no-commit my_ref_name
fi
git submodule update --init --recursive

steps.name: build
steps.run:
python3.12 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install --group openblas32 --group dev-cli
pip install --group test-extending

spin config-openblas --with-scipy-openblas=32
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$(pwd)/.openblas
python -m pip install . -v -Csetup-args="-Dallow-noblas=false"

steps.name: test
steps.run:
source venv/bin/activate
cd tools
python -m pytest --pyargs numpy
